tagline_after: in the claims market for the toughest situations that demand tenacity, creativity, flexibility and finesse.
paragraphs: Andrew has spent the better part of his career helping claimants navigate complex proceedings and accelerate recoveries. Trained as a bankruptcy lawyer, Andrew has deep expertise in workouts, chapter 11 restructurings, special situations investments and asset recovery strategies, seamlessly bridging traditional and digital assets.

Prior to founding Turnpage, Andrew built one of the leading marketplaces for trading bankruptcy claims, establishing deep relationships across the institutional buyer network that he draws on today. Andrew has traded or advised on billions of dollars in transactions — giving clients access to pricing, counterparties and execution that is difficult to replicate.

Andrew draws on early training as a mediator and strategy consultant to uncover the interests that drive each party in a transaction. He brings this foundation to every deal, deconstructing and allocating each component risk to the party best positioned to carry it and solving negotiation gaps that, on the surface, appear too wide to bridge.

Andrew has been quoted and featured in numerous media outlets and professional publications including the ABI Journal, the BBC, Benzinga, the Block, Bloomberg, Business Insider, CoinDesk, Grant's Interest Rate Observer, NPR's Planet Money, PBS, The New York Times, and the Wall Street Journal.
